- A single young shoot/leaf that has curled into a tight C-shape
- Yellowish-green to brownish coloration with distinct brown patches/lesions
- Crumpled, withered texture — clearly a damaged young tissue

**Matching against candidates:**

- **Cutting_Weevil**: "Brown, curled and crumpled young leaves" — the tight curl and browning of a young shoot fits well
- **Die_Back**: Reference shows elongated leaves curled lengthwise and fully dried/brown — the test image is a younger, more tightly curled shoot
- **Gall_Midge**: Shows blister galls on leaf surface — not matching

The tight C-curl of a young shoot with brownish crumpling strongly matches Cutting_Weevil symptomology, even though the reference collage emphasizes stripped shoots. The damaged, curled young tissue is the hallmark.
